2609.01532.title: Knowledge Distillation During Mid-Training Favors Reasoning over Factual Recall
2609.01532.paper_summary: Logit-based knowledge distillation (KD) is used to train smaller language models (LMs) via supervision from stronger teachers, but whether its benefits are consistent across training stages remains unclear. Through controlled experiments, we find that forward Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation--the standard KD formulation--with post-trained teachers behaves fundamentally differently during mid-training, an intermediate phase of self-supervised learning on curated corpora. Surprisingly, while forward KD simultaneously improves reasoning and factual recall during pre-training relative to standard next-token prediction (NTP), it instead slows factual recall acquisition during mid-training despite continued reasoning gains. We trace this stage dependence to an asymmetry in teacher confidence across data domains and the student's evolving knowledge state: teachers are more confident on procedural than knowledge-intensive data, while students acquire low-entropy factual knowledge earlier in training. To mitigate this imbalance, we propose Switch Distillation, a simple mid-training objective that distills on tokens where the teacher is confident, using teacher predictive entropy as a lightweight routing signal, and otherwise falls back to cross-entropy. Switch Distillation consistently outperforms existing distillation objectives across teacher sizes. Relative to standard NTP, it achieves 1.61-1.71x the reasoning performance and 1.13-1.19x the knowledge and commonsense performance while preserving 96.7-96.8% of factual recall. Crucially, these benefits persist after post-training: Switch Distillation closes the factual recall gap while maintaining 1.25-1.32x and 1.13-1.20x gains in reasoning and knowledge and commonsense, respectively.
2609.01532.paper_summary_zh: 基於Logit的知識蒸餾（KD）用於通過強大的教師對較小語言模型（LMs）進行訓練，但其在不同訓練階段的好處是否一致仍不清楚。通過控制實驗，我們發現前向Kullback-Leibler（KL）蒸餾——標準的KD公式——在中期訓練期間的表現與自我監督學習在策劃語料庫上的中間階段根本不同。令人驚訝的是，儘管前向KD在預訓練期間相對於標準的下一個標記預測（NTP）同時改善了推理和事實回憶，但在中期訓練期間卻減緩了事實回憶的獲取，儘管推理的增益仍在持續。我們將這一階段依賴性追溯到教師在數據領域上的信心不對稱以及學生不斷演變的知識狀態：教師在程序性數據上比在知識密集型數據上更有信心，而學生在訓練早期獲得低熵的事實知識。為了減輕這一不平衡，我們提出了Switch Distillation，一個簡單的中期訓練目標，對教師有信心的標記進行蒸餾，使用教師預測熵作為輕量級路由信號，否則回退到交叉熵。Switch Distillation在各種教師規模上始終優於現有的蒸餾目標。相對於標準NTP，它實現了1.61-1.71倍的推理性能和1.13-1.19倍的知識和常識性能，同時保持96.7-96.8%的事實回憶。關鍵是，這些好處在後訓練後仍然存在：Switch Distillation縮小了事實回憶的差距，同時在推理和知識及常識方面分別保持了1.25-1.32倍和1.13-1.20倍的增益。
